meta.title: Academia | The student platform for focus and achievement
meta.description: Academia: an organized smart library, subject communities, achievement tracking, a mistake bank and a national-exam simulator — all your studying in one place.

home.h1c: organizes them so you get things done.
home.sub: One place for every subject: a tidy library, questions that actually get answered, a schedule that reminds you, and practice exams that expose your weak spots before the real one.
home.featuresTitle: Everything you need in one place
home.featuresSub: Not a file archive — real tools that help you finish and master, built around how you actually study.

library.title: Smart library
library.text: A strict tree: term → subject → unit → lesson. Advanced search and favorites.

community.title: Subject communities
community.text: A channel per subject, Q&A with a pinned correct answer, and quiet hours at night.

tracker.title: Achievement tracking
tracker.text: A progress counter per subject, an interactive study plan, and a short Quiz after every lesson.

simulator.title: National exam simulator
simulator.text: Same format and timing, instant grading and weak-point analysis per unit.

mistakes.title: My mistake bank
mistakes.text: Every question you get wrong is saved automatically so you can review it until you master it.

review.title: 15-minute review
review.text: Smart flashcards suggested from your weakest point, before bed or before the exam.

student.d: A Dashboard with today's tasks, your progress, and your badges.

teacher.d: Upload your content, build Quizzes, and follow your sections' performance.

parent.d: A short weekly report on consistency and achievement.

meta.title: How Academia works | Getting started
meta.description: Four steps only: sign up and pick your role, set your system, grade and subjects, start from the organized library, and track your progress weekly.

howItWorks.sub: From your first sign-in, four quick steps (skippable anytime) and you're ready.

role.d: Student, teacher, or parent — each role opens a completely different space with its own permissions.

system.d: Palestinian or Jordanian, the track (scientific/literary), and the grade — so the right content is tailored to you.

subjects.d: Choose the subjects you follow, and your Dashboard and library are built around them right away.

goal.d: A simple goal that starts the achievement counter from minute one, and kicks off your Streak.

next: Finish a lesson, hit “Got it” and take a short Quiz.

Before the exam, the national-exam simulator tests you with real timing.

meta.title: Academia pricing | Start free
meta.description: A fully free plan to start, and a premium plan for the exam simulator, mistake bank and advanced reports.

pricing.sub: Start completely free. Upgrade to Premium whenever you need the exam-prep tools.

free.name: Free
features: Smart library and access to every subject

plus.name: Premium
features: Your own mistake bank + spaced repetition

pricing.note: Prices in US dollars. Cancel anytime.

faq.a: Yes — the free plan is complete with no time limit: the library, communities, schedule, and basic achievement counter. Premium is optional for advanced exam-prep tools.
Absolutely. Cancel your Premium subscription anytime from your account settings, no conditions or cancellation fees, and you'll keep access until the end of your paid period.

faq.q: What's the difference between the student and teacher plans?
faq.a: The student plan (free/premium) gives access to content and tools. The teacher plan is separate and lets you upload content, build quizzes, and track your students' performance.

faq.q: Do you offer discounts for school groups?
faq.a: We're currently building special packages for schools and groups. Reach out via the Help page and we'll get back to you with details.

faq.q: Where is my data stored, and is it secure?
faq.a: Your data is stored securely and encrypted, and we never share it with third parties for marketing purposes. Full details are on our Privacy Policy page.

compare.title: Compare the plans in detail
compare.sub: See exactly what you get with each plan before deciding.

meta.title: Academia for teachers | Organizing and assessment tools
meta.description: Upload your content once, build auto-graded Quizzes, and track your students with clear reports.

forTeachers.h1: Teach more, grade less, reach more students.
forTeachers.sub: Academia gives you an organized home for your content, auto-graded Quizzes, and analytics that show exactly where to focus.

upload.d: Upload files and videos once; they are classified automatically by term, subject, unit and lesson.

analytics.d: See who understood and who is struggling, and exactly which unit is the weak point.

income.d: A commission on the subscriptions of students linked to you, with a clear payouts dashboard.

verified.d: Verify by uploading an ID/certificate; once approved your badge appears next to your name.

faq.q: How do I become a verified teacher?
faq.a: Sign up via "Start as a teacher", fill in your details and qualifications, and our team reviews your application within a few days.

faq.q: How does the revenue share work?
faq.a: You earn a share of the subscription revenue from students who take your courses, and you can track your earnings anytime from the teacher dashboard.

faq.q: What kind of content can I upload?
faq.a: Written lessons, PDF files, question banks, and short quizzes — all organized by grade, subject, and unit.

privacy.intro: Last updated: platform launch. Written in plain language because it actually concerns you.

sections.d: Your name, email, the system, grade and subjects you pick, and your activity on the platform (lessons completed and Quiz results).
To tailor your content, compute your achievement rate, and suggest the right reviews. We never sell your data to third parties.
A parent sees only a weekly summary of consistency and achievement — not your community chats or daily activity details.
Teachers are responsible for the rights to the content they upload. Reported content is reviewed by moderation and may be removed.
You can request deletion of your account and data at any time from settings or by contacting support.

terms.intro: By using Academia, you agree to the following.

sections.d: One account per person, with accurate details. Sharing your account may lead to suspension.
Questions and answers are for learning. Abuse or inappropriate content is reported and reviewed by moderation.
Do not upload content you don't own the rights to. Violating content is removed; repeats may suspend the account.
The monthly subscription renews automatically and can be cancelled anytime, staying active until the paid period ends.
The exam simulator is an AI-based practice tool, not an official substitute for ministry resources.
